products.title: ComfrtCore™ 2.0 Sculpt High-Waist Legging
products.body_html:
The Sculpt High-Waist Legging does exactly what its name promises: a built-in sculpting waistband smooths your silhouette while soft, 4-way stretch fabric moves with you.

  • Slick, smooth fabric: 4-way stretch built for all-day comfort
  • Fitted through hip, thigh, and leg: true to size for a second-skin feel
  • Sculpt waistband: an extra-layered waistband for a smooth, supportive hold, without the squeeze
  • Wider front seam: designed for a smoother, more contoured silhouette
  • Sculpting back seam: a deeper back seam for a lifted, shaped look
  • Side seam pocket: a secure spot for the essentials
  • Sweat-wicking finish: helps keep you dry and fresh

Perfect for:

  • Workouts that call for full range of motion
  • Grocery store run in something that feels as good as it looks
  • Layering under an oversized hoodie for a polished look
